component.name: cecilia
component.summary: Edit and play guitar tab, notation and Gregorian chant

description.p: A keyboard-first editor and player for guitar tablature, standard notation and Gregorian chant. It reads Guitar Pro files (GP3 to GP8), MusicXML, MIDI and GABC, writes Guitar Pro, MusicXML, MIDI and GABC, and plays along with a recording.
Chant is edited in a WYSIWYG square-notation editor, not as text.
